report.clinical_summary: Patient with CLL on monitoring-only treatment (blood tests every 4 months) experiencing new symptoms: persistent neck lumps, night sweats, fatigue, and headaches that started after beginning medication. Fatigue significantly impacts work and daily activities. Has supportive partner but keeps emotional aspects to self. Trying to stay positive and focused on what they can control, but expresses concern about progression and medication side effects.
